1809-5929-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1809-5929-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5413-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
5413-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability, giving Trenching Steed +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

7299-8205.description:
Cast Kindred Judgment by paying its mana cost, choosing a creature type that no opponent controls a creature of, destroying all creatures not of the chosen type.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.
7299-8205.notes: You will also lose the game if you control no creatures as Biorhythm resolves, causing the game to end in a draw. You can avoid this by putting a creature onto the battlefield after step 1, by having an indestructible creature, or by controlling a creature that is of the type you name when casting Kindred Judgment. Similarly, any opponent who controls an indestructible creature and/or creature of the named type (including a creature with changeling) will not have 0 life or lose the game.

2113-4222-8039.description:
Activate Spireside Infiltrator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Spireside Infiltrator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Spireside Infiltrator.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-4050-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-4050-5631.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness, adding {1}{B}
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Skeleton Crew.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1594-4399-4518-6823.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Aunt May trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4518-6823.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

27-3259-5434.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-3259-5434.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

5457-7282-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
5457-7282-7340.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater.

1636-2034-5803-7249.description:
Cast Wildcall by paying its mana cost.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Wildcall.
Resolve the copy of Wildcall, causing you to put a card from your library onto the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the face-down creature, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3

483-997-5170-6132.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

141-2292-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.

2438-5220-6094-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

874-2866-4050-4986.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2866-4050-4986.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1594-2060-4770-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

4050-5220-5741.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
4050-5220-5741.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2173-2438-4063-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

460-539-5833.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more creatures.
460-539-5833.description:
Activate Leafkin Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Leafkin Druid.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

3484-5391-5902-6291.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3484-5391-5902-6291.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a tapped 3/3 Robot and a tapped 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Robot and Thopter enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1339-1479-5621-6674.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
1339-1479-5621-6674.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Kodama and Rydia trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rydia trigger, causing you to rummage.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Rydia trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2043-4365-5231-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {R}{R}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

654-5222-5686-6644.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

654-678-2438-6644.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

3967-6431--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

488-641-874-1492-4986.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Delif's Cone or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-874-1492-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-2292-5748.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one historic permanent card in your graveyard.
141-2292-5748.description:
Cast What Must Be Done by paying {3}{W}{W}, targeting any historic permanent card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting What Must Be Done.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying What Must Be Done, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of What Must Be Done, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

803-1571-2154-5728.notablePrerequisites: Aspiring Champion does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
803-1571-2154-5728.description:
Cast Sylvan Tutor by paying {G}, searching your library for Blightsteel Colossus and putting it on top of your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aspiring Champion.
Aspiring Champion triggers, causing you to sacrifice it, then reveal Blightsteel Colossus from the top of your library and put it onto the battlefield as a Demon due to Arcane Adaptation, then causing Blightsteel Colossus to give each opponent eleven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

396-2232-2459.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
396-2232-2459.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying commander tax, if applicable.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Blessed Sanctuary.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary, creating a 2/2 Unicron creature token.
The Unicorn enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

651-876-1709.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Task Force.
651-876-1709.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Lightning Greaves ability, attaching it to Task Force.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Task Force, causing the opponent to lose the game due to having zero or less life.

2034-2608-5168.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
2034-2608-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Derevi, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to have Derevi return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting Derevi onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Derevi enters the battlefield, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.

1283-1651-2713-2797.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Servo token.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Servo token.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Servo tokens, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat for infinite Servo tokens.
Once you have infinite Servo tokens, you may activate Retrofitter Foundry's third and then fourth ability for infinite Construct tokens, and Chromatic Orrery's second ability for infinite card draw.

1636-2908.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1636-2908.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {1}{U}.
Dream Stalker enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Dream Stalker.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm's trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Dream Stalker's trigger, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

198-1978-5089.description:
Animate Empowered Autogenerator using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {1} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
198-1978-5089.notes: The combo assumes Empowered Autogenerator has no charge counters on it when you start. If it has charge counters, the mana cost is reduced by {1}.
